name: seven demand scenarios — must fail until scored to six

blocks.title: Gateway Urban
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Gateway urban transient and corporate mix with parent distribution — underwrite city competitive set.

blocks.title: Corporate-Led Urban
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Corporate accounts when product matches brand ladder; confirm negotiated rates.

blocks.title: Regional & Secondary Markets
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Secondary markets when fee load clears local ADR; diligence source markets.

blocks.title: Resort & Coastal Leisure
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Leisure resort fit depends on amenity model vs coastal seasonality.

blocks.title: Conversion & Repositioning
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Conversion path for independents seeking affiliation and loyalty access.

blocks.title: Highway & Interstate Transient
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Highway limited-service economics sit outside this product and fee structure.

blocks.title: Airport & Transportation
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Airport edge demand is selective; underwrite dwell patterns before assuming fit.
